bounded_next_gate.matched_attribution: For each saved normal, compute exact unfiltered and matching-filtered supports. A positive gap under both is higher Boolean coupling; a gap only under matching filtering uses physical local exclusions. Rank filtering is redundant on this frozen cohort.
